name: Feeling Sorry ('Cause I Really Knew Nothing)
source:
An ordinary girl chanced to make acquainted with 4 boys who live in a training facility. At the facility, they live a life that overturn accepted common life. Who they are. A girl learn something by their life. Or She'll lose everything because concern herself in them. Depends on your choice.

[From [url=http://www.braveesprit.com/english/soft.html]Brave Esprit[/url]]
translation:
一个普通女孩偶然结识了住在训练设施里的四名男孩。他们在设施中的生活，颠覆了人们对日常生活的常识。他们究竟是什么人？女孩会从他们的生活中有所领悟，还是会因牵涉其中而失去一切？一切取决于你的选择。

[摘自[url=http://www.braveesprit.com/english/soft.html]Brave Esprit[/url]]
